adoption_reason: No quality gain demonstrated on the fresh reserved set, with approximately twice the elapsed time. Keep structured verification optional and traceable; retain the existing default.
evaluation_protocol: Fresh sources frozen before first structured development results. V1/V2 failures informed V3 through development cases only. Final V3 was frozen before reading reserved baseline scores; each policy evaluated once on the same fresh set. No changes against reserved outcomes.
limitations: Small authored synthetic sets, single observations per policy, not independent external annotations or production quality/security evidence. Reserved cases are now consumed.
